condition_description: NPR comparison requires matched numerator role, pressure type, location, time basis, and ambient denominator.
outside_boundary_behavior: Apparent Mach-disk scaling can reflect definition mismatch rather than physics.
notes: Mechanistic compatibility boundary, not a numeric regime boundary.

condition_description: Formation, instantaneous, overshoot, and stabilized Mach-disk states are distinct.
outside_boundary_behavior: A nominal or plateau NPR cannot reconstruct early-time motion.
notes: Event alignment required.

condition_description: Matched NPR does not match species density, sound speed, real-gas state, or exit turbulence.
outside_boundary_behavior: Gross barrel scale may remain similar while downstream cells and mixing differ.
notes: Apparent differences are complementary observables.

condition_description: Penetration and entrainment trends depend on nozzle geometry and transient/spatial definition.
outside_boundary_behavior: Pressure-ratio increase need not produce a universal monotonic penetration trend.
notes: CON-001 resolved as an apparent condition difference.

condition_description: Fixed-NPR and fixed-injection-pressure ambient sweeps are not interchangeable.
outside_boundary_behavior: Ambient pressure, density, and temperature can change timing and spreading through different paths.
notes: Keep ambient state components explicit.

condition_description: Shock-dominated near field and weaker-shock far-mixing region require separate descriptions.
outside_boundary_behavior: Notional-nozzle or equivalent-jet assumptions may fail if initialized too early or with unvalidated decay.
notes: No universal decay constant is asserted.

condition_description: Shock-front passage, shocked-state exposure, expansion-wave-limited loading, and total forcing are non-equivalent intervals.
outside_boundary_behavior: Duration-response conclusions change with the selected start/end events.
notes: Use interval_type and event links.

condition_description: Comparable We requires matched velocity, density, length, surface tension, Mach context, and loading history.
outside_boundary_behavior: Comparable We alone can yield different morphology or breakup timing.
notes: CON-010 resolved as a definition difference.

condition_description: Early kinematics and later morphology/spreading are different response stages.
outside_boundary_behavior: A weak early Mach effect does not negate later compressibility-dependent morphology.
notes: CON-002 resolved as different physical stage.

condition_description: Internal wave topology depends on wave-speed ratio, phase state, shock strength, and model geometry.
outside_boundary_behavior: Focusing, cavitation, or circulation may change or be omitted outside the modeled state.
notes: Do not transfer two-dimensional or omitted-physics results unqualified.

condition_description: Tandem and parallel arrangements invoke wake shielding versus channel closure and cannot share one critical spacing.
outside_boundary_behavior: Spacing can delay breakup in one arrangement and intensify it in another.
notes: CON-006 resolved as arrangement-dependent mechanism.

condition_description: Shock attenuation depends on volume fraction, exchange area, d0, shock strength, and inclusion of fragmentation.
outside_boundary_behavior: Neglecting fragmentation can overpredict transmitted pressure.
notes: Dilute-cloud results are not dense-spray boundaries.

condition_description: First and later ligament-shedding events can have different sensitivity to We and time.
outside_boundary_behavior: A single breakup time or morphology label can hide the multistage cascade.
notes: C004 missing limits broad taxonomy only.

condition_description: Critical Weber values are meaningful only within an explicit taxonomy and definition-complete forcing state.
outside_boundary_behavior: Thresholds shift when velocity, density, length, Mach, or loading definitions change.
notes: Tested range is not automatically a universal regime boundary.

condition_description: Breakup and evaporation overlap for sufficiently small droplets or strong-wave conditions within the tested liquids and gas histories.
outside_boundary_behavior: Larger droplets or different thermal histories may deform/break before evaporation matters.
notes: No universal size threshold is asserted.

condition_description: Vapor-layer/Stefan-flow suppression depends on Stefan number, volatility, density ratio, and model coefficients.
outside_boundary_behavior: Heating-induced property changes may instead promote breakup.
notes: CON-003 shows different mechanisms rather than contradiction.

condition_description: Heating promoted breakup in the modeled n-decane/n-heptane cases at We 15-90 and 600-1000 K.
outside_boundary_behavior: Direction cannot be extended to other liquids, We, or Stefan-flow regimes.
notes: Reported study range, not universal boundary.

condition_description: For tested droplets above 100 micrometres, evaporation negligibly affected deformation over the observation interval.
outside_boundary_behavior: Smaller droplets, later breakup, or higher-Stefan conditions may show phase-change influence.
notes: CON-004 resolved by size/time/thermal differences.

condition_description: Detonation droplet trends depend on droplet size, wave strength, liquid, and transition from stripping to coupled KHI-RTI piercing.
outside_boundary_behavior: Shock-derived coefficients may fail even when directional trends remain.
notes: Strong-wave domain only.

condition_description: Equal leading-shock Mach does not match post-wave velocity, sound speed, pressure gradient, chemistry, or duration.
outside_boundary_behavior: Later cavitation, drag, deformation, and breakup diverge.
notes: CON-005 resolved as scale/history difference.

condition_description: Injector-generated spray shocks depend on exit velocity, rate ramp, ambient sound speed/density, and timing; hot dense engine conditions may suppress formation.
outside_boundary_behavior: A visible spray shock in one vessel does not imply formation in every engine condition.
notes: Nozzle-exit velocity is not spray-tip velocity.

condition_description: Reflected-shock interaction and injector-generated near-nozzle shock impose different loading histories.
outside_boundary_behavior: Penetration and angle responses need not have the same direction.
notes: CON-007 resolved as different physical stage and wave origin.

condition_description: Premixing and combustion-mode shifts depend on sequence, dwell definition, fuel pair, ambient state, geometry, and operating point.
outside_boundary_behavior: An optimum timing or emissions response need not transfer across operating points.
notes: Direct A-library condition boundary.

condition_description: Pilot/main overlap can accelerate main-fuel ignition or disrupt/delay pilot ignition depending on chronology and geometry.
outside_boundary_behavior: Direction reverses when interaction changes from product-assisted ignition to pilot disruption.
notes: Do not convert correlation into a universal causal direction.

condition_description: Droplet/evaporation scale must be defined relative to refill, reaction, or wave scale for a specific fuel, chemistry, geometry, and wave number.
outside_boundary_behavior: Wave multiplicity, speed deficit, unburned pockets, or extinction vary with the chosen scale system.
notes: L_E/L_D is not a validated HPDI scale.

condition_description: Direct HPDI transfer requires co-located time-resolved gas shock and pilot-droplet response under matched geometry and chronology.
outside_boundary_behavior: Without those measurements the arrow remains project-level cross-scale inference.
notes: Central M03/M11 boundary.

condition_description: A closed shock-breakup-evaporation-mixture-ignition claim requires a single condition-matched chain of measurements or validated simulation.
outside_boundary_behavior: Separate supported component relations do not establish the continuous causal chain.
notes: Central M07-M09/M11 boundary.
